WHAT'S INSIDE

A terminal for people who aren't at a bank.

Everything you need to follow the market, in one place, without a subscription.

Charts that move
TradingView candles, technicals and financials for any listed company, full screen when you need room.
Alerts by email
With OpenStock Cloud, set a target above or below the price. We check every five minutes and write when it crosses.
Sentiment in one read
Buzz and bullishness from Reddit, X.com, news and Polymarket, side by side for each stock.
The whole market
Sector heatmap, movers and top stories on one screen before the bell.
Find anything with ⌘K
Search every exchange Finnhub covers and open a stock as a tab, like a browser.
A Monday digest
A short, AI-written summary of the week’s news for the stocks you watch.

DATA

Pick how fresh your numbers are.

Charts always stream live from TradingView. Quotes, watchlists and alerts come from Finnhub, and this is how often they update.

Setup guide

SELF-HOST

Your server, your keys, live quotes.

Add as many free Finnhub keys as you like: each one adds 60 requests a minute. Switch the data mode to realtime and prices refresh every 15 seconds.

Full setup in the README
$ git clone https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock.git
$ cd OpenStock

# .env (every variable is in the README)
FINNHUB_API_KEYS=key_one,key_two,key_three
NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime

$ docker compose up -d --build
